title: ചിതൽ പുരാണം Amazing Termite Mounds | Swarming behavior & Their Secret Life ഈയാമ്പാറ്റ #termite
description:
In this video, we explore the fascinating world of termites and the termite mounds they build. These tiny insects create massive, complex structures that act as their homes, complete with natural air conditioning and intricate tunnels.

👉 What are termites?
👉 Why do they build such large mounds?
👉 How do they survive in extreme environments?

Watch to learn about the role of termites in the ecosystem and the engineering marvels of their mounds. Filmed in the natural surroundings of Blathur, this documentary-style video is perfect for nature lovers, students, and curious minds.
How termites build giant, naturally ventilated mud mounds
The role of termites in soil health and the ecosystem
Swarming behavior – when winged termites leave the colony in huge numbers to form new colonies
Swarming usually happens during certain seasons and is one of nature’s most spectacular insect events. Don’t miss this up-close look at these tiny yet powerful engineers of nature.
